item.title: Bottom of Oxford Road, corner of Cambridge Gardens, 3rd September
item.description:
Stored clothes and other dumped items are becoming a regular occurrence in the area. Illegal street traders appear to be leaving goods in advance of the Saturday London Car Boot Sale at St Augustine’s School, despite the clear “No Street Selling” signs. We urge the Council to take immediate steps to remove these items and to take enforcement action, including fines, against illegal street trading and fly-tipping. Allowing goods to remain on the pavement simply encourages more dumping, while leaving local residents to deal with the resulting mess. After the weekend, unwanted clothes and other items are routinely left strewn across the surrounding streets and park. This is having a visible and increasingly detrimental effect on the neighbourhood and on the residents who live here.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Cambridge Gardens, London
Report on FixMyStreet
